## HEADNOTE
Sample Tenancy Act, 2001, Section 12 - written notice - an emailed notice satisfies the requirement of writing if receipt is proved.
## FACTS
The landlord sent the tenant a notice by email and filed for eviction after thirty days. The tenant denied having seen the email.
## ARGUMENTS
The tenant argued that only paper notice is written notice. The landlord argued that email is a written communication.
## REASONING
The purpose of Section 12 is that the tenant receives thirty days' warning in a durable form. An email is a durable written record. The landlord must prove that it reached the tenant, and here the delivery receipt and the tenant's reply were on record.
## HOLDING
Email notice is written notice under Section 12 when receipt is proved. The eviction proceedings are maintainable.
